d: Long, straight silver-blue hair with a center part and long bangs frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, sharp crimson eyes. The build is slender with a large bust, wearing a minimal dark brown bikini top accented with a gold center bead and gold bracelets on the wrists. The hair is styled with two blue ribbons and gold ornaments topped with white wing-like protrusions on each side of the head. A large white folding fan with blue floral patterns is held in front of the chest.
